protected_inputs.scope: Existing frontend source, evaluation/training material, and all pre-existing evaluation reports.

live_observation.code_snapshot_note: Exact source and fixture bytes for this live run were archived before the final report-status-only fix.

model_documentation.interpretation: Requests used the legacy chat name; observations returned flash. Do not label these as a pinned historical Chat/V3 model experiment.

engineering_changes: Candidate generators use one configured model, explicit temperature and token budget; provider journals retain requested/response model identifiers.
Versioned cache binds dataset, model configuration, code, corpus, index and runtime limits. Legacy reports are not silently resumed.
Same bounded retry policy for all methods; short/partial answers and low scores never cause selective regeneration. All attempts retained.
401 login retries preserve the same user and request body. Evaluation SQL is isolated; Mem0, background maintenance and web search are disabled.
Judge API failure is unknown score, not a clinical zero. Enforce finite score dimensions, safety veto and no-source grounding cap.
Report backend completeness, judge coverage, score denominators, omissions and costs separately; no invented tokens or statistical superiority claims.
Export question snapshots, full answers, sources, per-dimension score/reasons, traces and every attempt to per-case JSON, JSONL and CSV.
remaining_work: Trace the three historical low-score cases without modifying or automatically rerunning the frozen benchmark.
Investigate unnecessary answer expansion and per-stage context overhead; current N=2 is chain acceptance only.
Same-family judge bias, semantic reference accuracy, and over-deletion require separate calibration/professional review.
Source hashes establish text identity and positions, not clinical correctness or remote model-weight identity.
